exc: 公司计划在三年内把销售额翻一番。

cn: 三倍的；三重的；三倍数；三倍量；使增至三倍
ex: Our small team tripled its output after the new machine arrived.
exc: 新机器到货后，我们小组的产量提高了两倍。

ex: The price of the house could quadruple in ten years.
exc: 这栋房子的价格十年内可能涨到四倍。

ex: Twelve is a multiple of both three and four.
exc: 十二是三和四的公倍数。

ex: The maximum speed on this road is sixty kilometres per hour.
exc: 这条路的最高限速是每小时六十公里。

ex: You need a minimum of ten points to pass the test.
exc: 这次考试最少要拿十分才能通过。

ex: The journey takes approximately two hours by fast train.
exc: 坐快车这段路程大约需要两个小时。

ex: The chart shows how sales rose during the summer months.
exc: 这张图显示了夏季几个月销售额的上升情况。

ex: Look at the graph to see where the line drops.
exc: 看这张图，找出线下降的地方。

ex: The teacher drew a simple diagram of the human heart.
exc: 老师画了一张简单的人体心脏示意图。

ex: The results are listed in the table on page ten.
exc: 结果列在第十页的表格里。

ex: The data were stored in a matrix with four rows.
exc: 这些数据被存在一个四行的矩阵里。

ex: A rectangle has four sides and four right angles.
exc: 长方形有四条边和四个直角。

cn: 立方体；立方；三次幂；立方的东西
ex: A cube has six equal square faces and twelve edges.
exc: 立方体有六个相等的正方形面和十二条棱。

ex: Measure the angle with a ruler and a protractor.
exc: 用直尺和量角器量一下这个角。

ex: Every triangle has three sides and three inner angles.
exc: 每个三角形都有三条边和三个内角。

cn: 斜纹的；对角线的；对角线；斜纹织物
ex: Draw a diagonal line from one corner to the other.
exc: 从一个角到另一个角画一条对角线。

ex: Keep your back straight while you lift the heavy box.
exc: 搬重箱子时要保持背部挺直。

ex: The children sat in a circle around the fire.
exc: 孩子们围着火坐成一圈。

ex: We walked round the lake twice before breakfast.
exc: 早饭前我们绕着湖走了两圈。

ex: Put a small dot on the map where you live.
exc: 在地图上你住的地方画一个小点。

ex: The earth is not a perfect sphere but close to one.
exc: 地球不是一个完美的球体，但很接近。

ex: An ice cream cone melted in the hot sun.
exc: 一个冰淇淋蛋筒在烈日下融化了。

ex: To some extent, I agree with what she said.
exc: 在某种程度上，我同意她说的。

ex: The width of the door is only eighty centimetres.
exc: 这扇门只有八十厘米宽。

ex: The length of the river is over a thousand miles.
exc: 这条河的长度超过一千英里。

ex: Write the answer as a decimal, not as a fraction.
exc: 把答案写成小数，不要写成分数。

ex: About thirty percent of the students walk to school.
exc: 大约百分之三十的学生走路上学。

ex: A large proportion of the land is used for farming.
exc: 大部分土地都用于耕种。

ex: The unemployment rate fell for the third month running.
exc: 失业率连续第三个月下降。

ex: The ratio of boys to girls in the class is two to one.
exc: 班上男生和女生的比例是二比一。

ex: She finished only a fraction of the work before lunch.
exc: 午饭前她只完成了工作的一小部分。

cn: 刻度；规模；攀登 scales 天平；鳞
ex: The map is drawn on a scale of one to fifty thousand.
exc: 这张地图是按五万分之一的比例绘制的。

ex: Add one ounce of sugar to the mixture and stir.
exc: 往混合物里加一盎司糖，然后搅拌。

ex: The density of ice is lower than that of water.
exc: 冰的密度比水低。

ex: Water boils at two hundred and twelve degrees Fahrenheit.
exc: 水在华氏二百一十二度沸腾。

ex: Old thermometers used mercury, which is now banned in many places.
exc: 老式温度计用水银，如今很多地方已禁用。

ex: My phone battery died in the middle of the call.
exc: 我的手机电池在通话中途没电了。

ex: This small battery gives only one and a half volts.
exc: 这块小电池只提供一点五伏电压。

cn: 辐射；发散；从中心向四周散开
ex: Warm air radiates from the old stone walls at night.
exc: 夜里，暖空气从古老的石墙中散发出来。

cn: 散发 (光、热、气等)；发出（声音）
ex: The lamp emits a soft yellow light over the desk.
exc: 台灯在书桌上方发出柔和的黄光。

ex: The box has a transparent lid so you can see inside.
exc: 这个盒子有个透明盖子，你能看到里面。

ex: The tree is hollow inside, but it still grows leaves.
exc: 这棵树里面是空的，但还在长叶子。

ex: The ozone layer protects us from harmful sunlight.
exc: 臭氧层保护我们免受有害阳光的伤害。

ex: Gravity pulls every object toward the centre of the earth.
exc: 重力把每个物体拉向地心方向。

ex: Friction between the tyres and the road keeps the car steady.
exc: 轮胎与路面之间的摩擦让车子保持稳定。

ex: Our neighbour is eccentric, but everyone likes him anyway.
exc: 我们的邻居很古怪，但大家还是喜欢他。

ex: The new bridge displaced hundreds of families from their homes.
exc: 新桥让数百个家庭离开了自己的家。

ex: Boil the water first, then add the tea leaves.
exc: 先把水烧开，再放茶叶。

ex: The snow will melt quickly in this warm wind.
exc: 在这样的暖风里，雪很快就会融化。

ex: Sugar dissolves faster in hot water than in cold.
exc: 糖在热水里比在冷水里溶解得快。

ex: The old gate has rusted badly after years of rain.
exc: 多年雨水之后，这扇旧门生锈得很厉害。

ex: The juice is left to ferment for about two weeks.
exc: 果汁要放大约两周让它发酵。

cn: 冲淡；稀释；稀释了的；减弱了的
ex: Dilute the medicine with water before giving it to children.
exc: 给孩子服药前要用水把药稀释。

ex: This acid can burn your skin, so wear thick gloves.
exc: 这种酸会灼伤皮肤，戴上厚手套。

ex: The factory released noxious fumes into the night air.
exc: 工厂把有害的烟气排放到夜空中。

ex: The picture on the screen stayed static for a long time.
exc: 屏幕上的画面长时间静止不动。

cn: 无生气的；惰性的；不活泼
ex: Helium is an inert gas that rarely reacts with anything.
exc: 氦是一种惰性气体，很少与其他物质反应。

ex: There is an inherent risk in every kind of sport.
exc: 每一种运动都有其固有的风险。

cn: 公式；方程式；原则；配方；分子式
ex: The formula for the area of a circle is easy to remember.
exc: 圆面积公式很容易记住。

ex: Each component of the engine must be checked carefully.
exc: 发动机的每个部件都必须仔细检查。

ex: Water is composed of hydrogen and oxygen.
exc: 水由氢和氧组成。

ex: The mixture of flour and water forms a soft dough.
exc: 面粉和水的混合物会形成柔软的面团。

ex: Blend the butter and sugar until the mixture is smooth.
exc: 把黄油和糖搅拌到混合物顺滑为止。

ex: His theory explains why the sky looks blue.
exc: 他的理论解释了天空为什么看起来是蓝色的。

cn: 经验主义的；以实验为依据的
ex: The claim rests on empirical evidence rather than on opinion.
exc: 这一说法依据的是实证证据，而不是个人看法。

cn: 实际的；有用的；务实的；心灵手巧的
ex: She gave me some practical advice about saving money.
exc: 她给了我一些省钱的实用建议。

ex: The old doctrine was slowly replaced by a new one.
exc: 旧学说慢慢被新的学说取代了。

ex: He refused the offer as a matter of principle.
exc: 出于原则，他拒绝了这个提议。

ex: Learning a language requires patience and daily discipline.
exc: 学一门语言需要耐心和每天的自律。

ex: The new term begins on the first Monday of September.
exc: 新学期在九月的第一个星期一开始。

ex: I will take four courses this semester, including statistics.
exc: 这学期我要修四门课，包括统计学。

ex: The new timetable gives us two free afternoons.
exc: 新的课程表给了我们两个空闲的下午。

ex: My schedule is full, but I can meet you on Friday.
exc: 我日程排得很满，不过周五可以见你。

ex: The deadline for applications is the end of this month.
exc: 申请的截止日期是这个月底。

ex: She signed up for a short course in photography.
exc: 她报名参加了一个短期摄影课程。

ex: Today's lesson was about the history of the city.
exc: 今天的课讲的是这座城市的历史。

ex: The school added coding to its curriculum last year.
exc: 学校去年把编程课加进了课程体系。

ex: The seminar on climate change lasted almost three hours.
exc: 关于气候变化的研讨会持续了将近三个小时。

cn: 论坛；讨论会；公开讨论广场
ex: Students raised the issue at an open forum on Monday.
exc: 学生们在周一的公开论坛上提出了这个问题。

ex: The syllabus lists every reading for the whole term.
exc: 教学大纲列出了整个学期的所有阅读材料。

ex: The new system saves the company a lot of time.
exc: 新系统为公司节省了大量时间。

ex: He has only a rudimentary knowledge of Japanese.
exc: 他只懂一点最基础的日语。

ex: The course teaches basic skills like reading and writing.
exc: 这门课教授读写等基本技能。

ex: Honesty is a fundamental part of any good friendship.
exc: 诚实是任何良好友谊的根本部分。

ex: My daughter is still at elementary school, in grade three.
exc: 我女儿还在上小学三年级。

ex: The book had a profound effect on my way of thinking.
exc: 这本书对我的思维方式影响深远。

ex: The surface of the lake was calm and perfectly clear.
exc: 湖面平静，清澈见底。

ex: Attendance is compulsory for all first-year students at this college.
exc: 这所学院的一年级学生必须出席。

ex: Two years of experience is a prerequisite for this job.
exc: 两年工作经验是这份工作的必备条件。

ex: The university is highly selective and accepts few applicants.
exc: 这所大学选拔很严格，录取的申请者很少。

ex: I chose an elective on film because it looked fun.
exc: 我选了一门电影选修课，因为看起来有意思。

ex: The assignment must be handed in before Friday noon.
exc: 作业必须在周五中午之前交。

ex: Please submit your essay through the online system.
exc: 请通过在线系统提交你的论文。

ex: I always preview the chapter before the lecture begins.
exc: 我总是在上课前先预习这一章。

ex: She reviews her notes every evening for twenty minutes.
exc: 她每天晚上复习笔记二十分钟。

ex: He revised his report three times before sending it.
exc: 他把报告修改了三遍才发出去。

ex: Officials came to inspect the kitchen early this morning.
exc: 官员们今天一早来检查厨房。

ex: Consult a doctor if the pain does not go away.
exc: 如果疼痛不消退，就去看医生。

ex: I skimmed the article to find the main points.
exc: 我略读了那篇文章，找出要点。

ex: She scanned the page quickly for her own name.
exc: 她快速扫视那一页，找自己的名字。

ex: The committee scrutinised every line of the budget.
exc: 委员会仔细审查了预算的每一行。

ex: The children recited a short poem at the school concert.
exc: 孩子们在学校音乐会上朗诵了一首短诗。

cn: 让（某人）听写；命令；强行规定
ex: The manager dictated a letter to his new assistant.
exc: 经理向他的新助理口述了一封信。

ex: The final examination covers everything we studied this year.
exc: 期末考试涵盖我们今年学过的全部内容。

ex: We have a short test on Friday morning.
exc: 我们周五上午有一次小测。

ex: The teacher gave us a quick quiz on verbs.
exc: 老师给我们做了一次关于动词的小测验。

ex: Her presentation on renewable energy impressed the whole class.
exc: 她关于可再生能源的陈述让全班都很佩服。

ex: Copying another student's work means you have plagiarised.
exc: 抄别人的作业就意味着你抄袭了。

ex: Make a copy of the file before you edit it.
exc: 编辑文件之前先复制一份。

ex: Could you print two copies of this page for me?
exc: 你能帮我打印两页这个吗？

ex: He spent a whole year writing his master's thesis.
exc: 他花了整整一年写硕士论文。

ex: My essay was too long, so I cut two paragraphs.
exc: 我的文章太长了，所以删掉了两段。

ex: She read a paper on ancient trade routes at the conference.
exc: 她在会上宣读了一篇关于古代贸易路线的论文。

cn: 专题论文；（尤指）学位论文
ex: His dissertation examines how children learn a second language.
exc: 他的学位论文研究儿童如何学习第二语言。

cn: （大中学生的）专题研究；项目；方案
ex: Our group project is due at the end of the month.
exc: 我们的小组课题月底到期要交。

ex: Each chapter begins with a clear heading in bold type.
exc: 每一章都以醒目的粗体标题开头。

ex: From the outset, she knew the plan would be difficult.
exc: 从一开始她就知道这个计划不容易。

ex: He wrote a short outline before starting the essay.
exc: 他开始写文章之前先写了一个简短提纲。

ex: The main point of his talk was easy to follow.
exc: 他讲话的要点很容易听懂。

ex: I missed the details but caught the gist of it.
exc: 我漏掉了细节，但抓住了要点。

ex: In my opinion, the film is worth watching twice.
exc: 在我看来，这部电影值得看两遍。

ex: Let me introduce you to my colleague from the lab.
exc: 我来把你介绍给我实验室的同事。

ex: The article makes no reference to that old study.
exc: 这篇文章没有提到那项旧研究。

ex: Always cite your sources at the end of a report.
exc: 报告末尾一定要引用你的资料来源。

ex: The question was designed to elicit an honest answer.
exc: 这个问题的设计是为了引出诚实的回答。

ex: She quoted a line from a poem by Yeats.
exc: 她引用了一句叶芝诗中的句子。

ex: He extracted a short passage from the long report.
exc: 他从长报告里摘录了一小段。

cn: 摘要；抽象的；提取；把抽象出
ex: Please write a short abstract of your paper.
exc: 请为你的论文写一个简短摘要。

ex: Give me a brief summary of what happened at the meeting.
exc: 给我简单讲一下会上发生了什么。

cn: 假定；设想；承担（责任）；取得（权力）
ex: I assume the train will arrive on time today.
exc: 我假定今天火车会准时到。

ex: I presume you have already read the instructions.
exc: 我想你已经读过说明了。

ex: I suppose we should leave before it gets dark.
exc: 我想我们该在天黑前走了。

ex: The experiment was designed to test a simple hypothesis.
exc: 这个实验是为了检验一个简单的假设。

ex: Scientists postulate that the universe is still expanding.
exc: 科学家假定宇宙仍在膨胀。

ex: Reporters speculated about the reason for his sudden resignation.
exc: 记者们推测他突然辞职的原因。

ex: Nobody can predict exactly when the storm will hit.
exc: 没人能准确预测暴风雨什么时候来。

ex: I perceived a slight change in her tone of voice.
exc: 我察觉到她的语气有些细微的变化。

ex: The machine can detect very small amounts of gas.
exc: 这台机器能检测出极少量的气体。

ex: It was hard to discern his face in the dim light.
exc: 光线昏暗，很难分辨出他的脸。

ex: I did not recognise him after so many years.
exc: 这么多年过去，我没认出他来。

ex: She was conscious of every eye in the room.
exc: 她意识到屋里每个人都看着她。

ex: I reckon the trip will take about four hours.
exc: 我估计这趟行程大约要四个小时。

ex: The court deemed the evidence too weak to use.
exc: 法院认为这项证据太弱，无法采用。

ex: His silence seemed to imply that he disagreed.
exc: 他的沉默似乎意味着他不同意。

cn: 深思熟虑；仔细考虑；审慎的
ex: The judges deliberated for two days before deciding.
exc: 评委们商议了两天才作出决定。

ex: These figures represent the average rainfall for each month.
exc: 这些数字代表每个月的平均降雨量。

cn: 坚持；坚决认为（主张或要求）
ex: She insisted on paying for the whole meal herself.
exc: 她坚持自己付整顿饭的钱。

ex: The pain persisted for weeks despite the treatment.
exc: 尽管接受了治疗，疼痛还是持续了几周。

ex: I understand the rule, but I still find it strange.
exc: 我理解这条规则，但还是觉得奇怪。

ex: Few people can comprehend the size of the universe.
exc: 很少有人能理解宇宙有多大。

ex: We analysed the data and found a clear pattern.
exc: 我们分析了数据，发现了一个明显的规律。

ex: The doctor diagnosed her illness as a mild infection.
exc: 医生诊断她的病是轻度感染。

ex: From these numbers we can infer a steady decline.
exc: 从这些数字我们可以推断出持续的下降。

ex: Sherlock could deduce a man's job from his hands.
exc: 福尔摩斯能从一个人的手推断出他的职业。

cn: 推断出；得出结论；（使）结束
ex: The report concludes that the plan is too expensive.
exc: 报告的结论是这个方案太贵了。

ex: He drew an analogy between the brain and a computer.
exc: 他把大脑和计算机作了个类比。

ex: Compare the two pictures and list three differences.
exc: 比较这两幅图，列出三处不同。

ex: The contrast between the two cities is striking.
exc: 这两座城市的对比非常鲜明。

ex: Our duties overlap, so we often help each other.
exc: 我们的职责有重叠，所以常互相帮忙。

ex: There is a clear contradiction between his words and actions.
exc: 他的言行之间有明显的矛盾。

ex: I disagree with you on this point, but respect your view.
exc: 这一点我不同意你，但我尊重你的看法。

ex: The two versions differ only in the last paragraph.
exc: 两个版本只有最后一段不同。

ex: The city has a diverse population from many countries.
exc: 这座城市的人口来自许多国家，十分多元。

ex: A good translator catches every nuance of the original.
exc: 好的译者能捕捉原作的每一处细微差别。

ex: Inductive reasoning moves from examples to a general rule.
exc: 归纳推理是从例子走向一般规律。

ex: She explained the plan in great detail.
exc: 她非常详细地解释了那个计划。

ex: The police made a thorough search of the building.
exc: 警察对大楼进行了彻底搜查。

ex: This is a good example of how not to behave.
exc: 这是个不该怎样做人的好例子。

ex: In this instance, the rule does not apply at all.
exc: 在这种情况下，这条规则完全不适用。

ex: Please confirm your booking by email before Friday.
exc: 请在周五前用邮件确认你的预订。

ex: The teacher demonstrated the experiment to the whole class.
exc: 老师向全班演示了这个实验。

cn: （用图等）说明；给（书）加插图（或图表）
ex: The pictures illustrate how the machine works.
exc: 这些图片说明了这台机器如何运作。

ex: His anger manifested itself in a long, cold silence.
exc: 他的愤怒表现为长时间的冷淡沉默。

ex: You will have to prove that the story is true.
exc: 你得证明这个说法是真的。

ex: The test will determine whether you need more lessons.
exc: 这次测试将决定你是否需要多上几节课。

ex: We decided to stay home because of the heavy rain.
exc: 因为大雨，我们决定留在家里。

cn: 决心；决定；（使）分解为；解决
ex: They resolved the dispute without going to court.
exc: 他们没有上法庭就解决了争端。

cn: 民意调查；对进行民意调查
ex: A recent survey found that most workers feel tired.
exc: 最近一项调查发现大多数工人感到疲惫。

ex: Her research focuses on how plants survive in deserts.
exc: 她的研究关注植物如何在沙漠中存活。

ex: We observed the birds from a quiet corner of the park.
exc: 我们在公园一个安静的角落观察鸟儿。

ex: He inquired about the price of the small flat.
exc: 他询问了那套小公寓的价格。

ex: She sent a query about the missing payment.
exc: 她就那笔未到的付款发了一封询问函。

ex: Please fill in the questionnaire and return it tomorrow.
exc: 请填好问卷，明天交回。

ex: She achieved her goal after two years of hard work.
exc: 经过两年努力，她实现了自己的目标。

ex: We accomplished more in one week than expected.
exc: 我们一周内完成的事比预想的要多。
